description: PAID $0.015 USDC. Pairs each $1M+ sell or outflow with a similar-size buy or inflow from another entity (cross_entity) or the same entity (same_entity_round_trip) within 0-7 days. Sources: US spot ETF issuer holdings, SEC XBRL treasury filings, labeled Bitcoin exchange/custodian wallets (mempool.space) and Hyperliquid fills. Filters: asset, match_type, source_tier (all|institutional_only), min_usd, window_days, tolerance_pct, min_confidence, sort, limit. A match is a pairing, not proof of a counterparty.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

name: matched_orders
title: $1M+ matched buy/sell orders ($0.015)
